messages.subject: tabPanels not loading
parts:
I'm trying to output some tabels in the tabPanel 'Calculations' . If I don't use tabpanels, they load just fine. But with tabpanels they won't load. Does anyone have an idea what I'm doing wrong? Normally, the tabels are filled when you upload a jpg and place 5 landmarks on them (clicks). 

tabPanel("Picture", 
                 tags$style(type="text/css", "#wing img { max-width: 750px; max-height: 750px; } "),
                 tags$script(src='./mycanvas_ic.js'),
                 h4(id="maptitle"),
                 tags$style(type="text/css", "#wing img { max-width: 1000; max-height: 1000px; } #zoom {width: 200px; height: 200px; position: absolute; border: 1px solid #000; background-repeat:no-repeat; background-color:#FFF} #cross {width:                          5px; height: 5px; background-color: #FFFF00; margin-left: 97.5px; margin-top: 97.5px;"),
                 
                                
                 htmlOutput("wing"),
                 tableOutput("conclusion"),
                 div(id="landmarks" )
                 ), 
        
        tabPanel("Calculations", 
                 h3("Your Landmarks"),
                 tableOutput("hello"),


On another note, I tried to use javascript to hide the table 'conclusion'. I only want to display it when currentclicks == 5. This kinda works, but only the second time when currentclicks == 5 (it resets when currentclicks == 6). Does anyone have an idea whats going on here?

$(document).ready(function() {
      $('#conclusion').hide();
if(currentclicks == 5){
$('#conclusion').show();
}
if(currentclicks == 6) {
        $('#conclusion').hide();
         currentclicks = 0;
        LM = new Array();
        $('#landmarks').empty();
}

Thanks in advance, I really appreciate it!
Mart

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: tabPanels not loading
parts:
For the second issue, can you try this... after hiding or showing, trigger the 'shown' or 'hidden' event on that element, like this:

$('#conclusion').hide().trigger('hidden');

But it will also run into the same issue as the first problem, and that is, submitButton currently doesn't play nice with either tabsets or outputs that show/hide themselves. We're thinking of deprecating submitButton, in favor of actionButton/isolate. actionButton in the past has required the shiny-incubator package, but we've just added it to Shiny proper. It's not in the CRAN release yet but you can install it directly from GitHub with devtools::install_github("shiny", "rstudio").

So to summarize,

1) Trigger hidden/shown events when showing/hiding
2) Install latest Shiny
3) Get rid of submitButton and use actionButton + isolate instead
